# Derived fixtures — generated output, not captured

Unlike `tests/fixtures/golden/` (captured verbatim from a running MT5
terminal — see that directory's own README), files here are **generated by
a checked-in script running real project code against real captured
data**. They are reproducible, not hand-written, but they are also not
themselves evidence of what a broker sent — do not mix the two directories.

## What's here

| File | Generator | Produced from |
|---|---|---|
| `us100n_m1_swings_reference_20260915.jsonl` | `scripts/generate_swing_reference.py` | `tests/fixtures/golden/us100n_m1_bars_20260915.jsonl`, run through the real `vo.observation.swings.SwingEngine` (both INTERNAL and SWING tiers, per `config/settings/swings.yaml`) |

`us100n_m1_swings_reference_20260915.jsonl` exists so the MQL5 swing
indicator (`mql5/Indicators/VectorOdyssey/VO_Swings.mq5`, which has not yet
been compiled or run against a live MT5 terminal) has something
authoritative to be checked against once someone does: attach it to
US100.n on 1xTrade-Server with the same history loaded, and its boxes
should match this file's entries one for one.

## Keeping this in sync

`tests/unit/test_swing_reference_golden.py` pins every file here to a
fresh run of its generator. If that test fails, re-run the generator
script and commit its new output — never hand-edit a file in this
directory to make the test pass; that would be the same mistake the
golden/ README warns against, one step removed.
